Professional Summary

Results driven Engineering and Operations professional with 12+ years of progressive experience in engineering management, fire & life safety, project execution, consultancy, client coordination, and operational leadership. Currently serving as GM – Operations at Guard Tech Group, with hands-on experience managing engineering operations, multidisciplinary projects, technical teams, and client relationships. Experienced in fire detection and protection systems, EHS, testing & commissioning, fire safety consultancy, regulatory compliance, project planning, and technical coordination, with exposure to 200+ industrial, commercial, government, and multinational projects. Proven ability to lead teams, coordinate with clients, consultants, authorities, and internal departments, resolve technical challenges, optimize resources, and ensure timely, quality project delivery. MBA from the University of Dhaka; B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering; Member of The Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh (MIEB).

What I Do

Six areas where I bring engineering depth and management discipline to a project.

Fire & Life Safety Engineering

Design, coordination and delivery of fire detection and protection systems, supported by fire safety consultancy and professional membership of the Society of Fire Protection Engineers (USA).

Testing, Commissioning & Maintenance

Inspection, testing and commissioning of installed systems, followed by maintenance and clear documentation so they stay reliable and compliant.

EHS & Regulatory Compliance

Working with authorities, consultants and clients so that projects meet regulatory requirements and health, safety and environmental expectations.

Project Planning & Execution

Taking multidisciplinary projects from planning to handover: schedules, manpower, materials and resources, with technical quality checked along the way.

Operations & Business Leadership

Running business operations, procurement, logistics and process improvement, and supporting business development and strategic initiatives.

Client & Stakeholder Management

A single point of coordination between clients, consultants, authorities and internal departments, with negotiation and problem-solving to keep work moving.
